flags.note: Valley Electric swapped the Library meter on 14 August 2024. A facilities analyst entered these readings by hand.
The historian lost its link to the meter and interpolated between the readings either side.

provisional.note: Readings in the last day are unvalidated. The code clears once the day has passed, so a re-read sends the same value with no code.

eem.query: SELECT [TimeStamp], [Value], SourceClassification, SourceCode, Reader, Method, HistorianTag FROM SyntheticIntervalReadings WHERE Channel = 'ch_odbc_library_electric_kwh_30m' AND [TimeStamp] > DateAdd('h', -48, CDate('|LastTimeStamp|')) ORDER BY UtcTimeStamp
eem.note: Access SQL: TimeStamp and Value are reserved words, so they are bracketed. The query re-reads the last 48 hours so the provisional code's removal reaches Energy Hippo; an unchanged repeat is a duplicate.
